localChanges: On an isometric map, worked squares show Civilization II's own food, shield and trade icons once you import its ICONS.GIF in Import assets (#999).
ICONS.GIF is optional: the isometric map doesn't need it, and shows Civilization's icons until it is imported (#999).
On the isometric map, a square's yield icons now sit in the middle of the square instead of spilling over its neighbours (#999).

log: The digits in a coast quarter's name run anticlockwise round it: n-011 has land to the N and NW, not the N and NE. Checked against a real copy's sprites.
icons/food, shield, trade, luxury, gold and science are the 14×14 icons, and icons/small/ has the same six at 10×10. ICONS.GIF is optional: without it the map sprites are still extracted.
